name: Northwest Pipeline Grays Harbor Lateral

values.OtherEnglishNames: NWPL Gray Harbor; Grays Harbor Pipeline Project

researcher_notes: This is a 20-inch lateral of about 49 miles from the Northwest Pipeline system in Thurston County to the Satsop power plant in Grays Harbor County, Washington. It has no row of its own. The existing Northwest Gas Pipeline rows are the main system and other projects, so this is not a match. The EIA August 2026 release, Historical Projects sheet, Excel row 261, lists 48.9 miles, 20 inches, 160 MMcf/d added, cost 124 million dollars, completed November 2002, docket CP01-361. A Federal Register notice from March 2002 on the federal environmental assessment describes the same project and docket, about 49 miles of 20-inch pipe to Satsop. The two sources are independent. The cost of 124 million is from the EIA only; trade press at approval cited 75.2 million for the proposal. Start location is Thurston County, not a named town, because the exact tie-in point was not confirmed. Length is far above the 25 km floor, and the pipeline is built and in service. Route not researched here; the state energy facility siting council and FERC filings may hold alignment maps. Pipeline name follows the existing roster spelling Northwest Gas Pipeline. Owner shown as the source spells it; no legal form confirmed.
